Class StubOidcProvider

java.lang.Object
org.jwcarman.who.test.StubOidcProvider
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class StubOidcProvider extends Object implements AutoCloseable
A sign-in provider for tests: an OpenID Connect provider, or GitHub, on a random local port. It signs whoever nextUser(String, Map) names in, with no login page: /authorize redirects straight back with a code. Point a client registration at issuer() and drive the sign-in with a real browser, an HTTP client, or MockMvc. 
try (StubOidcProvider provider = StubOidcProvider.start()) {
  provider.nextUser("alice", Map.of("email", "alice@example.com", "email_verified", true));
  // spring.security.oauth2.client.provider.acme.issuer-uri = provider.issuer()
}

Requires com.nimbusds:nimbus-jose-jwt, which spring-security-oauth2-jose brings.
